_FIELD_TEST_ONLY: BRANCH feat/mdns-dev-build-0.7 -- DO NOT MERGE TO main-0.7.
The 'holochain' and 'hc' entries in this file are NOT the stock holochain 0.7.0
release artifacts. They are PATCHED binaries carrying the kitsune2 hello/PoK
access module plus mDNS LAN discovery, built from lightningrodlabs/holochain
branch feat/mdns-bootstrap-0.7.0-hello at commit 46f22e121431d64cb583d96d76d31262c2f6bb98
(kitsune2 rev a742244604c5b7d0994c213108abd67824dd9afc), destined for the fork
release lightningrodlabs/holochain @ holochain-0.7.0-mdns.1. The `binarySources`
block below is what repoints the fetch at that release.
mdns.1 fixes LAN discovery across a local address change: the mDNS responder now
rebinds when the host's addresses change, so a node that moves networks or gets a
new address keeps answering and finding LAN peers instead of going silent.
mdns.1 is otherwise additive on hello.2, keeping the same HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002, so
hello.2, mdns.0 and mdns.1 nodes interoperate.
Patched nodes advertise HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002 and reject stock peers at preflight,
so a build made from this branch CANNOT see stock Moss on the network. That is
deliberate -- it isolates the field-test cohort -- but it means every installer
handed to a tester must be built from this branch, and the release notes must say
so. See RUNBOOK-fieldtest.md.
'lair-keystore' and 'kitsune2-bootstrap-srv' are UNPATCHED. They have no
binarySources entry and therefore still come from the stock
holochain/holochain @ holochain-0.7.0 release. Do not add one.
PINNING STATE: the holochain-0.7.0-mdns.1 GitHub release does not exist yet (the
macOS arm64 build leg is still running). Only x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu is pinned,
